# City College of San Francisco (CCSF)

> > City College of San Francisco is a comprehensive community college offering career education, academic transfer programs, and student support services across diverse fields including business, arts, early childhood education, and African American Studies.

CCSF serves students through degree programs, certificates, and concurrent enrollment for high school students. The college integrates Canvas LMS for course management, maintains strong industry partnerships through advisory committees, and provides multicultural retention services and student health resources.

## Key Topics

- Career Education Programs
- Academic Transfer (CSU, UC Berkeley)
- Canvas LMS & Simple Syllabus
- Concurrent Enrollment (Dual Credit)
- Multicultural Retention Services
- Academic Senate Policies
- Student Success Stories
- Early Childhood Education
- African American Studies
- Business & Accounting Programs
- Photography & Visual Media
- Faculty Guidelines & Accreditation
- Student Health Services
- Campus Safety & Preparedness

## Registration & Academic Programs

- [Spring 2026 Registration](https://www.ccsf.edu/spring-2026-registration): Spring 2026 registration for career programs at CCSF
- [Concurrent Enrollment](https://www.ccsf.edu/academics/high-school-programs/concurrent-enrollment): Free dual credit program for California high school students
- [Business Programs Catalog](https://www.ccsf.edu/academics/ccsf-catalog/courses-by-department/business): Business programs catalog including accounting, real estate, and HR
- [African American Studies](https://www.ccsf.edu/degrees-certificates/african-american-studies): African American Studies degree program and Social Justice Studies AA-T

## Career Education & Departments

- [Photography Department](https://www.ccsf.edu/academics/schools/school-arts-communication-and-languages/photography-department): Photography Department with degrees, certificates, and studio training
- [Advisory Committees](https://www.ccsf.edu/academics/career-education/advisory-committees): Career education advisory committees with industry partnerships

## Student Support Services

- [Multicultural Retention Services (MRSP)](https://www.ccsf.edu/student-services/counseling/mrsp): Multicultural Retention Services offering academic support & counseling
- [Earthquake Preparedness](https://www.ccsf.edu/campus-police/earthquake-preparedness): Campus safety guide for earthquakes near San Andreas fault
- [Student Health Services Presentations](https://www.ccsf.edu/student-services/student-health-services/classstaff-presentations): Student Health Services presentations for classes and staff

## Student Success Stories

- [Story of CCSF](https://www.ccsf.edu/student-services/outreach-recruitment/story-ccsf): Student stories featuring early childhood education journeys at CCSF
- [Erica Calegari](https://www.ccsf.edu/academics/career-education/student-success-stories/erica-calegari): Erica Calegari's visual media design and graphic design success story
- [Louise Villalta](https://www.ccsf.edu/academics/career-education/student-success-stories/louise-villalta): Louise Villalta's career change from nursing to architecture

## Faculty Resources

- [Making a Great Syllabus](https://www.ccsf.edu/about-ccsf/participatory-governance/academic-senate/making-great-syllabus): Faculty guide for creating course syllabi with Canvas integration
